In the situation considered in H30026, the proposed operation in Mexico was the assembly of a direct current electric motor consisting of three components: the stator or rear housing, the rotor or armature assembly, and the end cap assembly. All three components are of Chinese origin and would be assembled into the finished good after importation into Mexico.
